notes.title: Update 0.7 : Hand to hand combat
notes.content:
You now have a melee attack
- For now, the melee attack has the same parameters, unaffected by the gun being held
- Cooldown : 1s
- Damage : 5 (for reference, crawler hp = 10, ghoul hp = 45)

Reworked input bindings for controller
- Melee attack : R3 (replaces swap weapon)
- Swap weapon : Arrow down (replaces torch on/off)
- Torch on/off : Arrow up (unused binding)
- Default binding for PC : Middle Mouse Click (rebindable)

QOL
- Added a tooltip for melee attack that triggers once if the player is damaged with an empty mag

notes.title: Update v.0.6.3
notes.content:
Visual
- Flag now always hangs behind the player character (it would hang in front of him sometimes)
- Fixed some objects (vegetation, props) not having a reflection in the water

QOL
- Boss UI now has 2 split sections during night 2, clearly indicating something happens at 50% HP.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a major bug where if a hunter died, dawn would be skipped and night would fall instantly 
-If the player is carrying the hunting flag & dies, the flag is now reset to its original position (it was brought with the player in the base before, causing other bugs)
- Player can now teleport over bridge if the bridge is built

notes.title: Update v.0.6.1
notes.content:
QOL improvements
- Backpack is now displayed when player tries reloading belt but has no ammo in it
- Player can now cancel Shoot speed & Move speed buffs
- Carrying flag improvements : player can now interact with other objects (structure locations, bridges) while holding the flag
- Added a small dead zone when aiming with the mouse around the player, if the pointer is within this dead zone aiming does not update.

UI changes
- Added a panel to describe full game in main menu
- This panel also opens when player exits game
- Added "Ratbit Games" logo in main menu
- Added "Wishlist" button in main menu
- Added "Wishlist" button in pause menu
- Made the bottom bar menu bigger in main menu

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a major bug where upgrades for items were not saved.
- Fixed input displayed on secondary ability with the correct input (F)
- Dropping the flag near a bridge does not drop orbs anymore

notes.title: Update v.0.6 : Cuteness for this dark world
notes.content:
You can now pet the doggo
- I'll let you discover the petting "system" in-game

Balancing
- The player now recovers his orbs if dropped in the water after a short delay.
- Debuffed the SMG Secondary : Shooting angle during overclock x2 -> x3
- Increased cooldown to add fuel to fire during the night : 3s -> 5s

Visual
- Changed the Eternal Fire's visuals to make it look more *eternal*
- Added subtle dust particles when the player and the dog run
- Fixed the shell ejected from the gun's particles size (increased size x5)
- Fixed the teleporting ability visuals

QOL improvements
- Removed the "switch structure function" tooltip as it is only used for one thing in the demo, bringing more confusion than anything else.
- The indicator under the ember as world object is now always active
- Added a tooltip when the player buys a new weapon
- Added a tooltip when the player tried swapping weapons during the first level ("My weapon was replaced")
- Fixed displayed input to swap weapon in controller mapping menu

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where the player could teleport out of the map 
- Fixed a bug where one creature would remain invincible at the end of a night
- Fixed a bug where the player could take damage & die in the teleporter
- UI & HP Ammo bars now hide when entering a teleporter
- Fixed tooltips to build structures appearing too often
- Fixed a bug where the first level portal would appear over a bridge
- Fixed a bug where the night music would stop when a player died during the night
- Fixed the night music not being affected by the music volume setting
- Animals do not collide with the portals anymore

notes.title: Update v.0.5 : Brightness setting & key binding icons
notes.content:
Added Brightness setting panel
- Shown on startup (as well as the "Language" Option)
- Available in the Main Menu settings, but unavailable in-game (complicated to implement in other scenes)

Misc
- Rebinding keys now also changes the icon linked to the binding shown in various in-game tips.
- Scaled down and rotated background icons in the Armorer's shop description cards.

notes.title: Update v.0.45 : Adaptive Main Menu & Balancing
notes.content:
Main Menu is now adaptive!
- The main menu background now changes to reflect the last environment where the player left the game from (Hub or level)

Balancing
- Added 2 new chests both left/right containing Orbs & Ammo to reward exploration and leave the player with ammo for the incoming night
- Dusk duration : 50s -> 60s
- Fixed the % of the sun arc trajectory allocated to Dawn, Day and Dusk to reflect their relative durations. From respectively 10%/60%/10% -> 10%/50%/20%
 - Reduced overall level difficulty during the day by 15%
- Slightly adjusted spawn parameters to have less enemies spawn close to the player camp, leaving more room for initial exploration

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where non-recruited workers would show "?" status when the player passes cross them.
-Fixed some clipping issues with text in the Trainer shop items in French & German
- Fixed some clipping issues in video tips in French & German

notes.title: Update v.0.4
notes.content:
I think this might be the last "major" update before the demo release. 

Emberlings can now talk!
Added talk lines to emberling when recruited, assigned as hunters and when dusk falls.

✨ QOL improvements
Added tooltips to build structures, assign hunters, craft ammo and light fire (Hold E to ...)
Added talk lines to emberlings to emphasize what "!" and "?" means when the player passes by ("danger ahead" and "no more prey")

📎 Misc
Added the Auto Reload option (turned off by default - for now bc it's fits better to the game experience I want to create)

notes.title: Update v0.35 : tweaks & bugfixes
notes.content:
🔧 Tweaks
Upgraded the dog's night behavior : dog should now run to the other side of the camp to warn the player creatures are incoming
Weapon stats now all update correctly when a weapon is upgraded
Increased the chest interactable area (this increases the chance of the player not standing right in front of the chest during the opening animation)
Changed the intro scene objective name to "Delay the inevitable"
Changed the "Slug" creature to make it more visible (red glowing eyes, reddish elements on its attack)

🇫🇷 🇩🇪   Localization 
Reworked the Settings Panel to have consistent font sizes
Localized the controller mapping menu

💻  UW Compatibility 
Fixed the main menu settings panel
Fixed the Trainer and Gem Trader shop panel compatibility issues

🪲  Bug Fixes
Infinite reload bug fixed
Dropping then collecting an orb no longer completes the "collect orbs from hunters" objective
Hub pause menu : changed "back to hub" text to "Main menu"
Saving in hub now also saves gems in the backpack
Merchants "unlocked" status is now saved
Mobs now only spawn relatively to the most exterior barricade (no longer takes the player's position in consideration)
Fixed one situation where the dog would switch between states every frame causing visual glitches (some situations where this happens might remain though)

notes.title: Demo Playtest v.0.3
notes.content:
Update v0.3

Major Addition
- Added the localization system ! 2 more languages are supported now: French and German.

QOL improvements
- The game now pauses when a tutorial is played
- Removed the "manage followers" key binding since it is not used in the demo
- Added a "holding currency" indicator above the hunters when they are carrying stuff
- Added an indicator hovering over the teleporter after level success
- Gun stats in the character menu now update instantly when an upgrade is bought
- Added a tooltip to teach the player to press "tab" to show the backpack's insides

Balancing
- Reduced all the bridges price to 3
- Moved the bridges and special interactables closer to the camp, in order to make building a bridge necessary to win the level, and "forcing" the player to discover the special interactables
- Added the Summoner as a roaming creature during the day
- Shortened the tutorial level by making the islands closer.
- Increased player movement speed by +10%
- Increased player sprinting speed by +3.5%
- Buffed boss speed by +10%
- Debuffed boss health by -10%

 Bug Fixes
- UW screen compatibility issues fixed
- Fixed a bug where the final creature of a wave would remain invincible and break the game.

Misc
- Changed the "Demo" letters font in the main menu to the Logo's artstyle
